title: Discover
body: We sit with your team and map the work as it actually happens. The bottlenecks tend to name themselves.

title: Design
body: We design the tool around the people using it. Prototypes you can click, not decks you can nod at.

title: Build
body: We build it, test it against real work, and adjust until it disappears into the day.

title: Automate
body: AI takes the repetition. Your people keep the judgement. We stay on hand while it beds in.
